networkIntros.instagram: Instagram is the shop window for many African businesses. Find followers, likes and views for your posts and Reels, with the price per 1,000 shown in XAF.
networkIntros.tiktok: On TikTok, the first views often decide how far a video goes. Pick followers, likes or views, check the minimum order, then pay from your balance with Mobile Money.
networkIntros.facebook: For a Facebook page or group, you can add followers, likes and views. Each service shows its price per 1,000 in XAF and its minimum quantity.
networkIntros.youtube: A YouTube channel starts better with visible views and subscribers. Compare services, quantities and the price per 1,000 before you order.
networkIntros.telegram: For a Telegram channel or group, choose members or views on your posts. Prices are per 1,000 and the minimum order is shown on each service.
networkIntros.x: For your X account, you can order followers, likes and views. Prices are in XAF per 1,000, with the minimum order shown before you pay.
networkIntros.spotify: For a Spotify artist or playlist, choose plays or followers. Each service shows its price per 1,000 in XAF and the accepted quantities.
networkIntros.whatsapp: For a WhatsApp channel or group, add followers or views. You see the price per 1,000 in XAF and the minimum order before you pay.

delivery.question: My order has not started yet, what should I do?
delivery.answer: An order usually starts within minutes, sometimes up to a few hours. If nothing moves after 24 h, open a ticket with the order number.

partial.question: My order was only partly delivered, why?
partial.answer: Sometimes only part of the quantity can be delivered. You are then charged only for what was delivered, and the rest is returned to you.

refund.question: Can I get a refund?
refund.answer: Every request is reviewed by our team. Open a ticket explaining the problem: we reply within 24 h.

rechargeMissing.question: I paid but my balance did not change.
rechargeMissing.answer: A payment can take a few minutes to arrive. If nothing changes after 30 minutes, open a ticket with the amount and the time of the payment.

privateLink.question: Why must my link be public?
privateLink.answer: A private account or post cannot receive the order. Make the account public during delivery, then set it back to private.
